name: Swashbuckler (Optimal Shenanigans Games)
body:
Alignment: Any

Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s swashbuckler class levels gains the swashbuckler’s swashbuckler finesse class feature and gains amateur swashbuckler as a bonus feat.

Advanced Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s swashbuckler class levels and chooses swashbuckler for their advanced mentorship ability for the day gains the swashbuckler‘s deeds class feature. When determining which deeds the apprentice can perform, the apprentice’s effective swashbuckler level is equal to half his apprentice level minus 3. The apprentice can use the panache pool granted by their amateur swashbuckler feat to perform these deeds.

Cooperation Power

Key ability: Charisma

Apprentices who study a mentor’s swashbuckler class levels and chooses gunslinger for their cooperation power may spend a cooperation point as a free action to grant himself or an ally one grit or panache point. The ally must have a grit or panache pool to regain the grit or panache point and this ability cannot be used to gain more points than his or her maximum.
